credit: The Postnational Monitor — World of Averages / World of Facial Averages
method: Align and average multiple photographed faces into composite portraits
creator_tool_distinction: Lisa DeBruine states that the images used her website tools, but were not created by her or her research team.
source_sampling_statement: According to DeBruine’s quotation of the creator, sources were mostly Google Images and approximately 15–20 images were selected. These are not representative population averages.
visual_check: Downloaded KoreanAverageWoman and ChineseAverageWoman from the primary post and compared with the supplied composite grid; face appearance and blended backgrounds correspond. No biometric comparison was used.
uncertainty: The editor, date and source chain of the exact 41-cell collage are not established. Credit identifies the underlying portrait series, not a confirmed compiler of this layout.
